titulo: Huawei made a whole camera to attach to its latest phone
cuerpo: Over the last few years, Chinese Android manufacturers have followed Vivo's example of launching add-on "teleconverter" lenses for their flagship phones, enabling long-distance photography that the phones on their own could never match.
